What’s New Backstage Log In Sign Up Newsletter Sign Up Find a Dealer × ML-2 Metal Core Where to Buy Extreme Metal in a Compact Pedal With its extreme gain, the ML-2 is the most potent and heavy distortion pedal ever created by BOSS. It easily delivers massive distortion and gain with heavy lows for playing Nu Metal, Grind Core, Industrial, Hard Core, or any genre that requires crushing sound. The ML-2’s ferocious and biting tone will complement and cut through any blast beats your rhythm section can create.
